traditions.LXX: Ὢ ποιμένες
traditions.KJV: Woe be unto the pastors

1.english_reference: that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture !

traditions.WLC: מְאַבְּדִ֧ים וּ מְפִצִ֛ים אֶת צֹ֥אן מַרְעִיתִ֖ י
traditions.LXX: οἱ ἀπολλύοντες καὶ διασκορπίζοντες τὰ πρόβατα τῆς νομῆς αὐτῶν .
traditions.VUL: qui dispérdunt et dilácerant gregem páscuæ meæ ,
traditions.KJV: that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture !
saith the LORD .

2.english_reference: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel

traditions.WLC: לָ֠ כֵן כֹּֽה אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל
traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Ideo hæc dicit Dóminus Deus Israel
traditions.KJV: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel

2.english_reference: against the pastors that feed my people ;

traditions.WLC: עַֽל הָ רֹעִים֮ הָ רֹעִ֣ים אֶת עַמִּ י֒
traditions.LXX: ἐπὶ τοὺς ποιμαίνοντας τὸν λαόν μου
traditions.VUL: ad pastóres , qui pascunt pópulum meum :
traditions.KJV: against the pastors that feed my people ;

traditions.LXX: Ὑμεῖς διεσκορπίσατε τὰ πρόβατά μου ,
traditions.KJV: Ye have scattered my flock ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξώσατε αὐτὰ
traditions.KJV: and driven them away ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἐπεσκέψασθε αὐτά ,
traditions.KJV: and have not visited them :

2.english_reference: behold , I will visit upon you the evil of your doings ,

traditions.WLC: הִנְ נִ֨י פֹקֵ֧ד עֲלֵי כֶ֛ם אֶת רֹ֥עַ מַעַלְלֵי כֶ֖ם
traditions.LXX: ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐκδικῶ ἐφ᾽ ὑμᾶς κατὰ τὰ πονηρὰ ἐπιτηδεύματα ὑμῶν .
traditions.VUL: ecce ego visitábo super vos malítiam studiórum vestrórum ,
traditions.KJV: behold , I will visit upon you the evil of your doings ,
saith the LORD .

3.english_reference: And I will gather the remnant of my flock

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲנִ֗י אֲקַבֵּץ֙ אֶת שְׁאֵרִ֣ית צֹאנִ֔ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγὼ εἰσδέξομαι τοὺς καταλοίπους τοῦ λαοῦ μου
traditions.VUL: Et ego congregábo relíquias gregis mei
traditions.KJV: And I will gather the remnant of my flock

3.english_reference: out of all countries whither I have driven them ,

traditions.WLC: מִ כֹּל֙ הָ אֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר הִדַּ֥חְתִּי אֹתָ֖ ם שָׁ֑ם
traditions.LXX: ἐπὶ πάσης τῆς γῆς οὗ ἐξῶσα αὐτοὺς ἐκεῖ ,
traditions.VUL: de ómnibus terris , ad quas eiécero eos illuc :
traditions.KJV: out of all countries whither I have driven them ,

3.english_reference: and will bring them again to their folds ;

traditions.WLC: וַ הֲשִׁבֹתִ֥י אֶתְ הֶ֛ן עַל נְוֵ הֶ֖ן
traditions.LXX: καὶ καταστήσω αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν νομὴν αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: et convértam eos ad rura sua :
traditions.KJV: and will bring them again to their folds ;

3.english_reference: and they shall be fruitful and increase .

traditions.LXX: καὶ αὐξηθήσονται καὶ πληθυνθήσονται .
traditions.KJV: and they shall be fruitful and increase .

4.english_reference: And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them :

traditions.WLC: וַ הֲקִמֹתִ֧י עֲלֵי הֶ֛ם רֹעִ֖ים וְ רָע֑וּ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀναστήσω αὐτοῖς ποιμένας οἳ ποιμανοῦσιν αὐτούς ,
traditions.VUL: Et suscitábo super eos pastóres , et pascent eos :
traditions.KJV: And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them :

4.english_reference: and they shall fear no more , nor be dismayed ,

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹא יִֽירְא֨וּ ע֧וֹד וְ לֹא יֵחַ֛תּוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐ φοβηθήσονται ἔτι οὐδὲ πτοηθήσονται ,
traditions.VUL: non formidábunt ultra , et non pavébunt :
traditions.KJV: and they shall fear no more , nor be dismayed ,
neither shall they be lacking ,

traditions.LXX: λέγει Κύριος .
traditions.KJV: saith the LORD .

5.english_reference: Behold , the days come , saith the LORD ,

traditions.LXX: Ἰδοὺ ἡμέραι ἔρχονται , λέγει Κύριος ,
traditions.KJV: Behold , the days come , saith the LORD ,

5.english_reference: that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch ,

traditions.WLC: וַ הֲקִמֹתִ֥י לְ דָוִ֖ד צֶ֣מַח צַדִּ֑יק
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀναστήσω τῷ Δαυεὶδ ἀνατολὴν δικαίαν ,
traditions.KJV: that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch ,

5.english_reference: and a King shall reign and prosper ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ βασιλεύσει βασιλεὺς καὶ συνήσει
traditions.VUL: et regnábit rex , et sápiens erit :
traditions.KJV: and a King shall reign and prosper ,

5.english_reference: and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth .

traditions.WLC: וְ עָשָׂ֛ה מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּ צְדָקָ֖ה בָּ אָֽרֶץ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ποιήσει κρίμα καὶ δικαιοσύνην ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς .
traditions.VUL: et fáciet iudícium et iustítiam in terra .
traditions.KJV: and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth .

6.english_reference: In his days Judah shall be saved ,

traditions.LXX: ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις αὐτοῦ καὶ σωθήσεται Ἰούδας ,
traditions.KJV: In his days Judah shall be saved ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ Ἰσραὴλ κατασκηνώσει πεποιθώς ,
traditions.KJV: and Israel shall dwell safely :

6.english_reference: and this [ is ] his name whereby he shall be called ,

traditions.WLC: וְ זֶה שְּׁמ֥ וֹ אֲֽשֶׁר יִקְרְא֖ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοῦτο τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ὃ καλέσει αὐτὸν
traditions.VUL: et hoc est nomen quod vocábunt eum ,
traditions.KJV: and this [ is ] his name whereby he shall be called ,

traditions.LXX: Κύριος Ἰωσέδεκ .
traditions.KJV: THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS .

7.english_reference: Therefore , behold , the days come , saith the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵ֛ן הִנֵּֽה יָמִ֥ים בָּאִ֖ים נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο ἰδοὺ ἡμέραι ἔρχονται , λέγει Κύριος ,
traditions.VUL: Propter hoc ecce dies véniunt , dicit Dóminus ,
traditions.KJV: Therefore , behold , the days come , saith the LORD ,

7.english_reference: that they shall no more say ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἐροῦσιν ἔτι
traditions.KJV: that they shall no more say ,

7.english_reference: The LORD liveth , which brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt ;

traditions.WLC: חַי יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֶעֱלָ֛ה אֶת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
traditions.LXX: Ζῇ Κύριος ὃς ἀνήγαγεν τὸν οἶκον Ἰσραὴλ ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου ,
traditions.VUL: Vivit Dóminus , qui edúxit fílios Israel de terra Ægýpti :
traditions.KJV: The LORD liveth , which brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt ;

traditions.LXX: ἀλλά Ζῇ κύριος
traditions.KJV: But , The LORD liveth ,

8.english_reference: which brought up and which led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country ,

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶעֱלָה֩ וַ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵבִ֜יא אֶת זֶ֨רַע בֵּ֤ית יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵ אֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֔וֹנָ ה
traditions.LXX: ὃς συνήγαγεν ἅπαν τὸ σπέρμα Ἰσραὴλ ἀπὸ γῆς βορρᾶ
traditions.VUL: qui edúxit et addúxit semen domus Israel de terra aquilónis ,
traditions.KJV: which brought up and which led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country ,

8.english_reference: and from all countries whither I had driven them ;

traditions.WLC: וּ מִ כֹּל֙ הָֽ אֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִדַּחְתִּ֖י ם שָׁ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπὸ πασῶν τῶν χωρῶν οὗ ἐξῶσεν αὐτοὺς ἐκεῖ ,
traditions.VUL: et de cunctis terris , ad quas eiéceram eos illuc ,
traditions.KJV: and from all countries whither I had driven them ;

8.english_reference: and they shall dwell in their own land .

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπεκατέστησεν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν .
traditions.KJV: and they shall dwell in their own land .

9.english_reference: Mine heart within me is broken because of the prophets ;

traditions.WLC: לַ נְּבִאִ֞ים נִשְׁבַּ֧ר לִבִּ֣ י בְ קִרְבִּ֗ י
traditions.LXX: Ἐν τοῖς προφήταις . Συνετρίβη ἡ καρδία μου ἐν ἐμοί ,
traditions.VUL: Ad prophétas : Contrítum est cor meum in médio mei ,
traditions.KJV: Mine heart within me is broken because of the prophets ;

traditions.LXX: ἐσαλεύθη πάντα τὰ ὀστᾶ μου ,
traditions.KJV: all my bones shake ;

9.english_reference: I am like a drunken man ,

traditions.LXX: ἐγενήθην ὡς ἀνὴρ συντετριμμένος
traditions.KJV: I am like a drunken man ,

9.english_reference: and like a man whom wine hath overcome ,

traditions.WLC: וּ כְ גֶ֖בֶר עֲבָ֣ר וֹ יָ֑יִן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὡς ἄνθρωπος συνεχόμενος ἀπὸ οἴνου ,
traditions.VUL: et quasi homo mádidus a vino ,
traditions.KJV: and like a man whom wine hath overcome ,

9.english_reference: because of the LORD , and because of the words of his holiness .

traditions.WLC: מִ פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וּ מִ פְּנֵ֖י דִּבְרֵ֥י קָדְשֽׁ וֹ
traditions.LXX: ἀπὸ προσώπου Κυρίου καὶ ἀπὸ προσώπου εὐπρεπείας δόξης αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: a fácie Dómini , et a fácie verbórum sanctórum eius .
traditions.KJV: because of the LORD , and because of the words of his holiness .

10.english_reference: For the land is full of adulterers ;

traditions.KJV: For the land is full of adulterers ;

10.english_reference: for because of swearing the land mourneth ;

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי מִ פְּנֵ֤י אָלָה֙ אָבְלָ֣ה הָ אָ֔רֶץ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἀπὸ προσώπου τούτων ἐπένθησεν ἡ γῆ ,
traditions.VUL: quia a fácie maledictiónis luxit terra ,
traditions.KJV: for because of swearing the land mourneth ;

10.english_reference: the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up ,

traditions.LXX: ἐξηράνθησαν αἱ νομαὶ τῆς ἐρήμου ·
traditions.KJV: the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο ὁ δρυμὸς αὐτῶν πονηρός ,
traditions.KJV: and their course is evil ,

10.english_reference: and their force [ is ] not right .

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἡ ἰσχὺς αὐτῶν οὕτως .
traditions.KJV: and their force [ is ] not right .

11.english_reference: For both prophet and priest are profane ;

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי גַם נָבִ֥יא גַם כֹּהֵ֖ן חָנֵ֑פוּ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἱερεὺς καὶ προφήτης ἐμολύνθησαν ,
traditions.VUL: Prophéta namque et sacérdos pollúti sunt :
traditions.KJV: For both prophet and priest are profane ;

11.english_reference: yea , in my house have I found their wickedness ,

traditions.WLC: גַּם בְּ בֵיתִ֛ י מָצָ֥אתִי רָעָתָ֖ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ μου εἶδον πονηρίας αὐτῶν .
traditions.VUL: et in domo mea invéni malum eórum ,
traditions.KJV: yea , in my house have I found their wickedness ,
saith the LORD .

12.english_reference: Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery [ ways ] in the darkness

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵן֩ יִֽהְיֶ֨ה דַרְכָּ֜ ם לָ הֶ֗ם כַּ חֲלַקְלַקּוֹת֙ בָּֽ אֲפֵלָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο γενέσθω ἡ ὁδὸς αὐτῶν αὐτοῖς εἰς ὀλίσθημα ἐν γνόφῳ ,
traditions.VUL: Idcírco via eórum erit quasi lúbricum in ténebris :
traditions.KJV: Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery [ ways ] in the darkness :

12.english_reference: they shall be driven on, and fall therein

traditions.LXX: καὶ ὑποσκελισθήσονται καὶ πεσοῦνται ἐν αὐτῇ ·
traditions.VUL: impelléntur enim , et córruent in ea :
traditions.KJV: they shall be driven on , and fall therein :

12.english_reference: for I will bring evil upon them, [ even ] the year of their visitation

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי אָבִ֨יא עֲלֵי הֶ֥ם רָעָ֛ה שְׁנַ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֖ ם
traditions.LXX: διότι ἐπάξω ἐπ᾽ αὐτοὺς κακὰ ἐν ἐνιαυτῷ ἐπισκέψεως αὐτῶν .
traditions.VUL: áfferam enim super eos mala , annum visitatiónis eórum ,
traditions.KJV: for I will bring evil upon them , [ even ] the year of their visitation ,
saith the LORD .

13.english_reference: And I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria

traditions.WLC: וּ בִ נְבִיאֵ֥י שֹׁמְר֖וֹן רָאִ֣יתִי תִפְלָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν τοῖς προφήταις Σαμαρείας εἶδον ἀνομήματα ·
traditions.VUL: Et in prophétis Samaríæ vidi fatuitátem :
traditions.KJV: And I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria ;

traditions.LXX: ἐπροφήτευσαν διὰ τῆς Βάαλ ,
traditions.KJV: they prophesied in Baal ,

13.english_reference: and caused my people Israel to err

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּתְע֥וּ אֶת עַמִּ֖ י אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπλάνησαν τὸν λαόν μου Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.KJV: and caused my people Israel to err .

14.english_reference: I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing :

traditions.WLC: וּ בִ נְבִאֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם רָאִ֣יתִי שַׁעֲרוּרָ֗ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν τοῖς προφήταις Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἑώρακα φρικτά ,
traditions.VUL: Et in prophétis Ierúsalem vidi similitúdinem
traditions.KJV: I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing :

14.english_reference: they commit adultery , and walk in lies :

traditions.LXX: μοιχωμένους καὶ πορευομένους ἐν ψεύδεσι
traditions.KJV: they commit adultery , and walk in lies :

14.english_reference: they strengthen also the hands of evildoers ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀντιλαμβανομένους χειρῶν πολλῶν
traditions.KJV: they strengthen also the hands of evildoers ,

14.english_reference: that none doth return from his wickedness :

traditions.WLC: לְ בִ֨לְתִּי שָׁ֔בוּ אִ֖ישׁ מֵ רָֽעָת֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: τοῦ μὴ ἀποστραφῆναι ἕκαστον ἀπὸ τῆς ὁδοῦ αὐτοῦ τῆς πονηρᾶς ·
traditions.VUL: ut non converterétur unusquísque a malítia sua :
traditions.KJV: that none doth return from his wickedness :

14.english_reference: they are all of them unto me as Sodom ,

traditions.WLC: הָֽיוּ לִ֤ י כֻלָּ ם֙ כִּ סְדֹ֔ם
traditions.LXX: ἐγενήθησάν μοι πάντες ὡς Σόδομα ,
traditions.VUL: facti sunt mihi omnes ut Sódoma ,
traditions.KJV: they are all of them unto me as Sodom ,

14.english_reference: and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah .

traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ κατοικοῦντες αὐτὴν ὥσπερ Γόμορρα .
traditions.KJV: and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah .

15.english_reference: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts concerning the prophets ;

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵ֞ן כֹּֽה אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ עַל הַ נְּבִאִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: Διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Proptérea hæc dicit Dóminus exercítuum ad prophétas :
traditions.KJV: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts concerning the prophets ;

15.english_reference: Behold , I will feed them with wormwood ,

traditions.WLC: הִנְ נִ֨י מַאֲכִ֤יל אוֹתָ ם֙ לַֽעֲנָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: Ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ψωμιῶ αὐτοὺς ὀδύνην
traditions.KJV: Behold , I will feed them with wormwood ,

15.english_reference: and make them drink the water of gall :

traditions.LXX: καὶ ποτιῶ αὐτοὺς ὕδωρ πικρόν ,
traditions.KJV: and make them drink the water of gall :

15.english_reference: for from the prophets of Jerusalem is profaneness gone forth into all the land .

traditions.WLC: כִּ֗י מֵ אֵת֙ נְבִיאֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם יָצְאָ֥ה חֲנֻפָּ֖ה לְ כָל הָ אָֽרֶץ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἀπὸ τῶν προφητῶν Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἐξῆλθεν μολυσμὸς πάσῃ τῇ γῇ .
traditions.VUL: a prophétis enim Ierúsalem egréssa est pollútio super omnem terram .
traditions.KJV: for from the prophets of Jerusalem is profaneness gone forth into all the land .

16.english_reference: Thus saith the LORD of hosts

traditions.LXX: οὕτως λέγει Κύριος Παντοκράτωρ
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the LORD of hosts ,

16.english_reference: Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you

traditions.WLC: אַֽל תִּשְׁמְע֞וּ עַל דִּבְרֵ֤י הַ נְּבִאִים֙ הַ נִּבְּאִ֣ים לָ כֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: Μὴ ἀκούετε τοὺς λόγους τῶν προφητῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Nolíte audíre verba prophetárum , qui prophétant vobis ,
traditions.KJV: Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you :

traditions.LXX: ὅτι ματαιοῦσιν ἑαυτοῖς ὅρασιν ,
traditions.KJV: they make you vain :

16.english_reference: they speak a vision of their own heart

traditions.LXX: ἀπὸ καρδίας αὐτῶν λαλοῦσιν
traditions.KJV: they speak a vision of their own heart , [ and ]

16.english_reference: not out of the mouth of the LORD

traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἀπὸ στόματος Κυρίου .
traditions.KJV: not out of the mouth of the LORD .

17.english_reference: They say still unto them that despise me

traditions.LXX: λέγουσιν τοῖς ἀπωθουμένοις τὸν λόγον Κυρίου
traditions.KJV: They say still unto them that despise me ,

17.english_reference: The LORD hath said, Ye shall have peace

traditions.WLC: דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה שָׁל֖וֹם יִֽהְיֶ֣ה לָ כֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: Εἰρήνη ἔσται ὑμῖν ,
traditions.VUL: Locútus est Dóminus : Pax erit vobis :
traditions.KJV: The LORD hath said , Ye shall have peace ;

17.english_reference: and they say unto every one that walketh after the imagination of his own heart
